sensor: Thermal: vanadium oxide (VOx) uncooled focal plane detector, 1280x1024, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=20 mK; optical: 1/1.8" 4MP CMOS (2688x1520)
features: bi-spectrum thermal + visible positioning system (1280x1024 thermal + 4MP 56x visible)
long-range 100 mm athermalized thermal lens; visible 56x optical zoom (6-336 mm)
laser illumination and laser range finder up to 2000 m
heat detection up to 8000 m (100 mm lens)
heat detection, smoke detection, boat detection, tripwire, intrusion
3D positioning, cold/hot spot trace, target tracking, human/vehicle classification
auto rain-sensing wiper, optical and electronic defog, optical image stabilization
release_notes: Project-exclusive long-range thermal multi-spectral positioning system pairing a 1280x1024 uncooled VOx thermal channel (100 mm lens, heat detection to 8 km) with a 4MP 56x-zoom visible channel; laser illuminator and range finder to 2000 m, smoke/boat detection on a 24-57 VDC platform.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels; PTZ via ONVIF.
